spans.s:
The affix क्वरप्‌ comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. इ 'to go' 2. नश् 'to destroy' 3. जि 'to conquer' 4. सृ 'to flow'.

Terms: क्वरप्‌

The augment इट् is added to the Participial affixes त and तवत् after कुष् when it is preceded by निर्।

Terms: इट् augment
